recipes.name: Puerco Pibil inspired by Once Upon a Time in Mexico
ingredients: 5 pounds pork butt, trimmed and cut into 2 inch cubes
2 inch banana leaves, cut into 16 segments
instructions: Toast annatto seeds, peppercorns, cloves, cumin, and allspice in a dry sauté pan for 3-5 minutes over medium heat, until fragrant. Pour into a spice grinder and process into a fine powder, 2-3 minutes. - 5 tbsp annatto seeds - 1 tbsp black peppercorns - 1 tsp cloves - 2 tsp cumin seed - 8 allspice berries

In a blender, combine orange juice, vinegar, lemon juice, garlic cloves, habanero peppers, salt, tequila, and ground spices. Blend on high speed for 30-60 seconds, until well-combined. Combine marinade and pork in a large plastic bag, massage until evenly coated, and allow to marinate for 30 minutes. - ½ cup orange juice - ½ cup white vinegar - 5 juiced lemons - 8 cloves of garlic - 2 habanero peppers seeded and chopped - 2 tbsp salt - Splash of quality anejo tequila

Preheat oven to 325°F. Line a deep casserole dish with banana leaves, and pour pork into the center. Wrap banana leaves around the pork, seal tightly with aluminum foil, and roast for 4 hours. - 2 inch banana leaves cut into 16 segments - 5 pounds pork butt trimmed and cut into 2 inch cubes
Serve with rice, lime wedges, and cilantro. - Cooked white rice - Lime wedges - Cilantro

To serve with tacos: while pork roasts, combine red onion and mustard seeds in a large heatproof bowl, and cover with boiling apple cider vinegar. Let steep for 30 minutes, and serve over tacos. - 1 red onion sliced - 1 tbsp mustard seeds - 4 cups apple cider vinegar
